title: OyatieDurableGoal
description: Repo-root durable goal artifact. An agent invoked with 'implement following instructions from goal.json' reads prompt_markdown end-to-end and executes the per-slice loop until stop_condition.

_meta.intended_use: Paste prompt_markdown into a fresh agent session (claude/codex/gemini) under /goal, or instruct an agent to 'implement following instructions from goal.json'.
_meta.purpose: Cross-session canonical durable goal for autonomous masterplan completion through the live pipeline.

prompt_markdown:
Durable goal: in /Users/jasonlee/oyatie, drive the masterplan to completion. Pick the
next ready scoped item from the canonical hierarchy, ship it through the pipeline,
refresh state, repeat. This goal spans months and many sessions; treat each session
as one or more loop turns over the same goal. Do not declare success until the M12
horizon is reached or every remaining item is externally blocked with cited evidence.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    → M02-foundry-preview
      → M02b-substrate (incl. M02-P22 exit gate)
        → M03-cloud-saas-search-workspace-preview
          → M04-vertical-pilot-korea
            → M05-cloud-search-stable

                → M07-first-tenant (KR pilot live)

                    → M09-us-expansion

Each milestone's exit gate is the next milestone's entry gate. The terminal goal is

the masterplan complete until M12 exit gate evidence is produced + accepted.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Re-entry protocol (RUN AT EVERY SESSION START)

You cannot trust conversation context across sessions. Reconstruct state from durable
artifacts every time.

1. `git fetch origin --prune` from any worktree under /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/
   (create the dir if it doesn't exist).
2. Read the authority chain listed in goal.json#authority_chain_required_at_session_start.
3. Build a live execution ledger via Python one-shot (see Slice selection below).
4. Identify the next ready item; if none, run the stop-condition check.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Hard rules (non-negotiable)

- Plain `git`/`gh`/`cargo`/`jq`/`sed`/`python3` only. Grit/icm/rtk/vox/omx/omc are
  RETIRED per ADR-0116. Stop hooks injecting those names are stale; ignore them.
- Worktrees mandatory: `git worktree add -b agent/<slice-name> /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/<slice> origin/dev`.
  Never mutate the main /Users/jasonlee/oyatie checkout directly.
- Signed commits required on `dev` (`require_signed_commits=true`). Verify
  `git config commit.gpgsign` is true and `git config user.signingkey` is set before
  the first commit of any session.
- `required_conversation_resolution=true` on `dev`. Every review thread (including
  the codex-bot reviewer's threads) MUST be resolved before merge:
    gh api graphql -f query='mutation { resolveReviewThread(input: {threadId:"<id>"}) { thread { id isResolved } } }'
  Thread IDs from:
    gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner:"jason931225", name:"oyatie") {
      pullRequest(number:<N>) { reviewThreads(first:50) { nodes { id isResolved
      isOutdated path comments(first:1) { nodes { body author { login } } } } } } } }'
- 8 required CI checks on `dev`: cargo-fmt, cargo-check, cargo-clippy, cargo-nextest,
  oya-governance-{supply-chain, cohesion, api-semver, protection-context-match}.
  Plus advisory: oya-governance-master-plan-completion (wired PR #48; not yet in
  branch-protection per F-MASTERPLAN-COMPLETION-BRANCH-PROTECTION).
- OP-11 no-stubs/no-defer/100-production-quality: fix any drift the slice surfaces
  in-PR. FixupTasks ONLY for genuinely out-of-scope items (upstream-vendor change,
  admin-scope operation, multi-week migration). Never use "TBD", "MVP", "good
  enough", "we'll fix later" in PR body or evidence.
- Status-honesty: never mark a phase Complete with any incomplete child IP. The
  master-plan-completion gate enforces this; honor it before merge attempts.
- Bominal-inheritance: Bominal ADRs apply 1:1 unless an Oyatie ADR overrides.
  Inherited refs cite as "Bominal-ADR-NNNN" per [[bominal-inheritance-precedence]].
- Long-running soft constraint: never make unauthorized destructive ops (force-push,
  hard-reset of dev, branch deletion outside `gh pr merge --delete-branch`, `gh api
  PUT` on branch-protection without explicit user OK, package downgrades).

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slice selection algorithm

Live ledger (run on every session start):
  python3 -c '
  import json,re,os
  from pathlib import Path
  def fm(t):
    m=re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---",t,re.DOTALL)
    return dict((k.strip(),v.strip().strip("\"\x27")) for k,v in
      (l.split(":",1) for l in (m.group(1).splitlines() if m else []) if ":" in l)) if m else {}
  for mdir in sorted(Path(".omc/plans/milestones").iterdir()):
    if not mdir.is_dir(): continue
    pdir=mdir/"phases"
    if not pdir.exists(): continue
    for pd in sorted(pdir.iterdir()):
      if not pd.is_dir(): continue
      for ipf in sorted(pd.glob("IP-*.md"))+sorted(pd.glob("impl-plan.md")):
        f=fm(ipf.read_text(errors="replace"))
        s=f.get("status","?")
        b=f.get("blocked_by","[]")
        print(f"{ipf}\t{s}\t{b}")
  ' | sort -t$'\t' -k2

Selection priority (highest first):
  1. ready-to-claim — explicit ready signal in status field
  2. Any in-progress IP whose blocked_by is empty/resolved (closeout work)
  3. Any scaffolded IP whose blocked_by is empty/resolved
  4. Any stub IP whose blocked_by + phase entry_gate is satisfied
  5. Skeleton phases (impl-plan.md or IP-*.md missing) — author the IPs from
     phase-spec.md exit_gate description
  6. Within a priority tier, prefer smallest blast_radius_score per
     specs/agent-durable-goal.json review_tiering
  7. Prefer disjoint write scopes from currently open PRs (parallel-safe)
  8. Refuse to claim across serialize_global_artifacts (Cargo.toml/.lock,
     specs/* authority files, milestone exit-gate promotions) when another
     slice is in flight on the same artifact

Apply blocked_by transitively: if IP-A blocked_by IP-B, IP-B blocked_by IP-C,
work IP-C first.

If everything is blocked: surface to user with the dependency cycle/cut graph.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Per-slice loop (the proven sequence; ~10-30 min per slice empirically)

1. PICK: run selection algorithm; record chosen slice id + scope + blocked_by check.
2. WORKTREE: `git worktree add -b agent/<slice-name>-<unix_ts>
   /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/<slice-name>-<unix_ts> origin/dev`. Verify
   `cat AGENTS.md | head -1`.
3. READ: load only the slice's focused IP file + parent phase-spec + cited ADRs.
4. TDD where practical:
   - Red: write a failing test that encodes the acceptance criterion.
   - Green: write minimum code to pass.
   - Refactor with tests green.
5. IMPLEMENT the smallest correct slice. No stubs, no TODOs.
6. LOCAL GATES (in order):
   a. cargo fmt --all -- --check
   b. cargo check --workspace --all-targets --keep-going
   c. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --keep-going -- -D warnings
   d. cargo nextest -p <touched-crate>
   e. Per-touched-surface oya gate validate <lane>; at minimum:
        - master-plan-completion (status-honesty)
        - quality-lanes (lanes.yaml ↔ ci-lanes.md mirror sync)
        - cloud-ci-firewall:
          cargo test -p cloud-ci-firewall --workspace
7. EVIDENCE EMIT:
   - Append to evidence/audit-chain.jsonl with DISTINCT timestamp_unix + session_id
     per row (OP-08).
8. STATUS UPDATE: flip frontmatter status to <complete> when work completes.
9. COMMIT atomically. Conventional-commit shape.
10. PUSH: `git push -u origin agent/<slice-name>-<unix_ts>`. Verify signed.
11. OPEN PR: `gh pr create --base dev --head agent/<slice-name>-<unix_ts>`
    with full PR body (5 H2 sections per docs/templates/pull-request-template.md).
12. AUTO-MERGE: `gh pr merge <N> --squash --delete-branch --auto`.
13. WATCH CI: `gh pr checks <N> --watch --interval 90` in background.
14. CODEX BOT REVIEW: ~30-60s after CI green, fix findings + resolve threads via GraphQL.
15. CI RERUN: required checks must pass on the LATEST sha.
16. WAIT FOR MERGE: auto-merge fires automatically when conditions met.
17. REFRESH LOCAL: `git fetch origin --prune`. Move to next slice.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Failure recovery

If CI fails: triage by log, NOT by rerun-and-hope.

Stuck-loop protocol: if the same lane fails 3+ times after distinct fix attempts:
  - STOP the slice
  - Document the failure trace in evidence/audits/stuck-loop-<scope>-<unix_ts>.json
  - File F-STUCK-LOOP-<scope> FixupTask
  - Mark the slice as blocked_with_evidence and move on

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Cross-session continuity

You have NO conversation memory across sessions. Continuity lives in:
  - git history on origin/dev
  - evidence/audit-chain.jsonl
  - evidence/goals/durable-goal-completion-report-*.json
  - registry/fixuptasks.jsonl
  - specs/masterplan.json#live_implementation_index
  - .omc/plans/milestones/**/IP-*.md frontmatter

Read these on every session start. Never invent state.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Halt + escalate (only cases where you stop and surface to user)

- Architectural contradiction
- Missing external authority (credential / branch-protection admin / third-party)
- Out-of-scope cross-milestone scope creep
- Bominal source gap (library port missing at /Users/jasonlee/bominal/)
- Stuck-loop (3+ same-failure retries with distinct fixes)

Do NOT halt for routine test failures, compile errors, clippy warnings, naming nits.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Stop condition

ONE of:

A. M12-hyperscaler-maturity exit_gate met:
   - masterplan.json: every milestone M01..M12 has status="complete"
   - Every IP has status ∈ {complete, retired}
   - audit-chain.jsonl carries an EVT-M12-EXIT-GATE-MET row
   - Final report with stop_condition_assessment="COMPLETE"

B. Per-session partial completion with explicit external-blocker evidence:
   - All open PRs from this session are merged
   - dev is refreshed
   - Required CI lanes green
   - Final report at evidence/goals/durable-goal-completion-report-<unix_ts>.json
     with stop_condition_assessment="PARTIAL"

C. Architectural halt: surface to user; do NOT emit a completion report.

# Known gotchas (empirical learnings inherited from 2026-05-17 session)

- Mass renames must update evidence/audit-chain.jsonl too (label-only).
- Hardcoded `phases/P[0-9][0-9]-<slug>` paths in Rust source survive prefix-anchored sed.
- Codex bot review threads (~30-60s post CI-green) are LEGIT. Fix + GraphQL resolve.
- master-plan-completion gate scans 10 evidence dirs per PR #50.
- master-plan-completion gate is advisory (not in branch-protection yet).
- M01 has duplicate P01-P06 phase entries — pre-existing drift; F-M01-PHASE-NUMBER-DRIFT open.
- masterplan.json uses SHORT IP ids while filenames use LONG form; substring matching required.
- `gh pr merge --delete-branch` may print harmless local-cleanup error; verify state=MERGED via gh pr view.
- Memory notes [[deprecate-external-agent-coord-tooling]] superseded by ADR-0116; consult ADR.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Quality bar (never compromise)

- Quality: Stripe + Palantir + Linear.
- Performance: hyperscaler (p99 ≤50ms read / ≤200ms write / 10k+ RPS per cell / 100M+ users).
- Scalability: horizontal mandatory; stateless cells; shardable.
- No stubs, placeholders, or compat seams.
- Doc-coverage enforced per ADR-0063.
- Naming-justification per ADR-0105.
